controles.affirmation: La famille Lauren detient environ 85% des droits de vote
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "As of March 28, 2026, Mr. Ralph Lauren, or entities controlled by the Lauren family, held approximately 85% of the voting power of the outstanding common stock of our Company."

controles.affirmation: Environ 36% du capital economique face aux 85% de droits de vote
controles.verbatim_source: Proxy 2026 : "Class B Common Stock (currently representing approximately 86% of the voting power and 36% of the economic ownership of the Company)"
controles.correction_proposee: Precision possible : le proxy indique aussi que les avoirs classe A + classe B de M. Lauren et de sa famille representent "an approximate 37% economic interest".

controles.affirmation: Les produits sont concus « par, et sous la direction de, M. Ralph Lauren et nos equipes de design »
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "Our Ralph Lauren products are designed by, and under the direction of, Mr. Ralph Lauren and our design teams."

controles.affirmation: Remuneration FY2026 de Ralph Lauren 24,8 M$ superieure a celle du CEO Patrice Louvet 23,26 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Proxy 2026, Summary Compensation Table : Ralph Lauren, Executive Chairman and Chief Creative Officer, 2026 total 24 799 858 $ ; Patrice Louvet, President and CEO, 2026 total 23 264 269 $

controles.affirmation: Marge brute 73,7% au T1 FY2027 contre 72,3%, soit +140 pdb, principalement portee par l'AUR
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 FY2027 : "Gross profit as a percentage of net revenues increased to 73.7% (...) from 72.3% (...). The 140 basis point increase reflected favorable foreign currency effects of approximately 10 basis points. The remaining 130 basis point improvement was primarily due to mid-teens AUR growth as well as favorable channel and geographic mix shifts"
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le document cite l'AUR ET des effets de mix canal/geographie ; « la quasi-totalite de ce gain » attribuee au seul AUR est legerement au-dela du texte.

controles.affirmation: Sur FY2026 : 69,9% contre 68,6%, +130 pdb dont 100 lies a l'AUR
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "The 130 basis point improvement reflected favorable foreign currency effects of 30 basis points. The remaining 100 basis point improvement was primarily due to mid-teens AUR growth and product elevation, more than offsetting pressure from tariffs and non-cotton product costs."

controles.affirmation: Sur 84,1 M$ de hausse en Amerique du Nord, 41,9 M$ (la moitie) viennent du wholesale avec reprise de livraisons a un compte de luxe et decalage favorable de calendrier
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 FY2027 : "a $41.9 million increase related to our North America wholesale business, driven by strong selling trends and replenishment orders, including resumed shipments to a luxury wholesale account, and a favorable timing shift of inventory shipments." ; "Net revenues increased by $84.1 million, or 12.8%"

controles.affirmation: 48% de la valeur des produits FY2026 sourcee dans 3 pays (21% Vietnam, 16% Cambodge, 11% Inde)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "with approximately 21% of our products sourced from Vietnam, 16% from Cambodia, and 11% from India"

controles.affirmation: La Cour supreme a invalide en fevrier 2026 les tarifs IEEPA ; nouveaux tarifs sous une autre autorite ; remboursements incertains
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 FY2027 : "In February 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court invalidated the IEEPA tariffs previously applied to our foreign imports, after which the U.S. announced additional tariffs under other trade authorities." ; "While we have submitted refund claims for eligible IEEPA tariffs previously paid, the ultimate amount and timing of collection, and approval of any such refunds remain uncertain."

controles.affirmation: En Amerique du Nord la societe relie la hausse des ventes comparables a une « croissance de l'AUR proche de 20% », le trafic progressant en complement et non comme moteur principal
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 FY2027 : "The increase in our comparable store sales reflected high-teens AUR growth and higher traffic during the three months ended June 27, 2026"
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire « une croissance de l'AUR dans le haut de la fourchette des adolescents (high-teens, soit environ 17-19%) ». Le document met AUR et trafic sur le meme plan ("and higher traffic") sans hierarchiser : la mention « et non comme moteur principal » est une inference, a retirer ou a signaler comme telle.

controles.affirmation: 325,1 M$ de rachats d'actions au T1 FY2027, superieurs au resultat net de 262,2 M$
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 FY2027 : "Repurchases of common stock, including shares surrendered for tax withholdings (325.1)" et MD&A : "Class A common stock repurchases of $325.1 million, including $75.1 million of share withholdings in satisfaction of tax obligations related to the vesting of stock-based compensation awards"
controles.correction_proposee: Les 325,1 M$ incluent 75,1 M$ de retenues fiscales sur vesting. Les rachats effectifs sont de 250,0 M$, donc INFERIEURS au resultat net de 262,2 M$. Le titre « Rachats d'actions superieurs au resultat net du trimestre » s'inverse une fois cette composante retiree. Reformuler : « 325,1 M$ affectes aux rachats et retenues fiscales, dont 250,0 M$ de rachats effectifs, pour un resultat net de 262,2 M$ ».

controles.affirmation: Capitaux propres en recul de 2 841,4 M$ (28 mars 2026) a 2 721,6 M$ (27 juin 2026)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 FY2027, tableau de variation des capitaux propres : solde 2 841,4 puis 2 721,6
